title: Dark Futuristic SaaS Hero & Bento Grid
description: High-converting SaaS landing page with dark obsidian background, radiant cyan glow accents, responsive Bento feature grid, and live interactive metrics.
promptContent:
Create an ultra-modern, dark-mode SaaS landing page for an AI developer platform. Use React, Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons, and Framer Motion.

Key Design Specs:
1. Background: Deep obsidian (#090D16) with subtle radial cyan-to-violet gradient blurs (backdrop-blur-3xl).
2. Header: Sticky translucent glassmorphic navigation with logo, 'Features', 'Changelog', 'Docs', and a glowing 'Start Free' CTA button.
3. Hero Section:
   - Badge: 'v3.0 Engine Launched • 4x Faster' with shimmer animation.
   - Typography: Bold display heading 'Ship Autonomous AI Apps in Seconds, Not Weeks' with high-contrast gradient text.
   - Subheadline: Refined slate-400 copy explaining edge execution, zero cold starts, and single-click deploys.
   - Interactive Mockup: Card previewing live terminal streaming logs with syntax-highlighted code tabs.
4. Bento Grid (4 Columns / 2 Rows):
   - Cell 1 (Span 2): Live real-time latency chart with animated SVG line path.
   - Cell 2: One-click API key generator with instant clipboard copy feedback.
   - Cell 3: Multi-tenant security badge with rotating shield indicator.
   - Cell 4 (Span 2): Global edge network map showing 300+ PoPs with ping telemetry.
5. Micro-interactions: Smooth hover states, glowing borders (ring-1 ring-cyan-500/20), and buttery spring transitions.
systemInstruction: You are a world-class principal UI/UX frontend designer specializing in high-converting developer tools and dark-mode aesthetics.

title: Neo-Bank Financial Analytics Portal
description: Sleek institutional-grade FinTech dashboard featuring multi-currency wallets, virtual Visa cards, spending velocity charts, and instant transfer modals.
promptContent:
Build a responsive Neo-Bank and Wealth Analytics web app using Tailwind CSS, React, and Recharts.

Structure & Requirements:
1. Color Palette: Pure charcoal (#0A0C10), slate borders (#1E2638), accent emerald (#10B981) for positive alpha and electric blue (#3B82F6) for active cards.
2. Left Sidebar: Minimal icon bar with Home, Analytics, Cards, Invoices, Settings, and user avatar with verified badge.
3. Top Row Metrics: 4 summary cards showing Total Balance ($142,850.40), Monthly Outflow, Yield Earned (+8.4% APY), and Credit Utilization.
4. Center Showcase:
   - Virtual 3D-styled metallic card with toggleable CVV visibility, card freeze switch, and contactless icon.
   - Interactive Cashflow Area Chart with weekly, monthly, and YTD time range selectors.
5. Transaction Feed: Clean table displaying merchant logos, category tags, timestamp, and instant PDF invoice download button.
6. Quick Actions Drawer: Send money modal with recipient contact picker and instant biometric confirmation simulation.
systemInstruction: Act as an expert fintech product engineer. Focus on data density, clean typography, and zero clutter.

title: Editorial Minimalist Creative Portfolio
description: High-fashion typographic portfolio for digital art directors, 3D artists, and creative technologists with smooth mouse inertia and fullscreen modal showcases.
promptContent:
Design a breathtaking, high-fashion creative portfolio website using Vite, React, and Tailwind CSS.

Aesthetic Guidelines:
1. Layout: Editorial Swiss typography, generous whitespace (or rich dark mode #0C0C0C), serif display headers paired with clean sans-serif body.
2. Navigation: Sticky minimalist header with artist name 'AURA STUDIO', location 'TOKYO / BERLIN', and interactive sound toggle.
3. Hero: Massive typographic statement 'Designing tangible futures across digital & spatial mediums' with a fluid mouse-following cursor glow.
4. Project Index:
   - Alternating two-column project showcase with parallax image scaling on scroll.
   - Each project card reveals year, discipline, client, and a hover zoom effect.
5. Interactive Lightbox: Clicking any project triggers an immersive modal with high-res photo gallery, project brief, and design token inspection.
6. About & Contact: Minimalist footer with live local time in Tokyo and copyable email button with instant toast notice.
systemInstruction: Design with extreme taste, Swiss grid precision, and architectural balance.

title: Luxury Horology E-Commerce Showcase
description: Bespoke timepiece e-commerce store with 360-degree product inspection carousel, dial customization toggle, and 1-click Express Checkout drawer.
promptContent:
Create an ultra-luxury watch e-commerce product landing and cart experience in React and Tailwind CSS.

Specs:
1. Theme: Matte carbon black (#0D0D11) with warm champagne gold accents (#D4AF37) and crisp white typography.
2. Hero Showcase: Split screen. Left side features bespoke serif typography, chronometer certification badges, and case specs (41mm 904L Oystersteel). Right side displays interactive watch dial with colorway switchers (Obsidian, Midnight Azure, British Racing Green).
3. Feature Specs Table: Waterproof rating (300m), caliber movement details, and power reserve indicator bar.
4. Cart & Checkout Drawer:
   - Slide-over drawer with item summary, complimentary insured express shipping indicator, and coupon code input.
   - Apple Pay / Google Pay / Credit Card express checkout buttons with secure SSL padlock badge.
5. Customer Trust Section: Press citations (Monochrome, Hodinkee) and concierge customer support widget.
systemInstruction: You are a bespoke luxury brand designer. Every pixel must feel prestigious and tactile.

title: AI Code Copilot & Agent Terminal
description: Developer-first web interface mimicking an advanced agentic IDE with multi-file diff view, split terminal, and live prompt orchestration controls.
promptContent:
Construct a full-featured browser-based AI code agent control center using Next.js / React and Tailwind CSS.

Components:
1. Left Pane: File explorer tree with file type icons, git change badges (modified/untracked), and branch dropdown.
2. Center Pane: Split code editor and unified git diff viewer showing green insertions and red deletions with line numbers.
3. Bottom Pane: Integrated pseudo-terminal with command input, ANSI color support, and simulated build execution.
4. Right Inspector: Agent reasoning trace stream showing step-by-step tool invocations, tokens used, latency counter, and model selector dropdown (Claude 3.7 Sonnet, GPT-4o, DeepSeek R1).
5. Theme: VS Code dark modern theme (#181824, #1E1E2E) with syntax highlighting colors.
systemInstruction: You are an expert developer tooling architect. Build high-density, ergonomic UI controls.

title: Neo-Morphic Health & Sleep Tracker App
description: Mobile-first PWA interface for biometrics, REM sleep phase breakdown, daily hydration rings, and AI wellness coaching insights.
promptContent:
Build a mobile-first wellness and sleep tracking app interface optimized for iPhone/Android screens in React and Tailwind CSS.

UI Structure:
1. Status Header: Greeting with user streak (14 Days Burning 🔥), date chip, and quick notification bell.
2. Circular Health Rings: Three concentric SVG animated activity rings (Sleep Score 92%, Deep REM 2h 14m, Resting Heart Rate 54 BPM).
3. Weekly Sleep Bar Chart: Vertical bars showing sleep duration across Monday through Sunday with color-coded sleep quality indicators.
4. AI Bio-Coach Advice: Dismissible frosted glass card offering customized recovery tips based on circadian rhythm.
5. Bottom Tab Bar: Floating pill navigation with Home, Vitals, Trends, and Profile with spring physics active indicator.
systemInstruction: Focus on biometric data visualization, soothing dark indigo backgrounds, and touch targets >= 44px.

title: Cyber Threat Intelligence & SOC Monitor
description: Mission-critical cybersecurity command center with live attack packet animation, CVE risk scoring, and zero-trust policy toggle switches.
promptContent:
Design a high-density Security Operations Center (SOC) dashboard in React, Tailwind CSS, and Lucide icons.

Components:
1. Global Threat Severity Ribbon: Dynamic banner with DEFCON status, blocked DDoS vectors in past 24h (2,419,002), and average time to mitigate.
2. Live Packet Ingestion Feed: Monospace log window showing timestamp, source IP, geolocated flag, destination port, and protocol (TCP/UDP/WAF) with color-coded severity badges.
3. Threat Map: Dark world map with pulsing animated radar blips indicating real-time geo attacks.
4. Firewall Policy Control: Table with granular IP blocking, CIDR range input, rate-limiting throttle toggles, and instant rule deploy button.
systemInstruction: Build an uncompromising enterprise security portal with high data density and monospace telemetry.

title: Audio Waveform & Podcast Creator Studio
description: Modern web audio recording and editing suite with multi-track waveforms, stem isolation toggles, and automated transcript sync.
promptContent:
Create a rich web-based audio mastering and podcast workstation UI using React, Tailwind CSS, and Canvas/SVG audio waveforms.

Features:
1. Top Transport Bar: Master volume slider, Play/Pause/Rewind controls, Timecode readout (00:14:28 / 01:05:00), and Project Export button.
2. Multi-Track Canvas: Three stacked visual tracks (Host Mic, Guest Remote, Background Ambience) each with canvas-rendered stereo waveforms, Mute, Solo, and Gain knobs.
3. Live AI Transcription Window: Right column displaying synchronized dialogue text with timestamp markers and editable speaker tags.
4. AI Enhancement Tools: Toggles for 'Room Echo Removal', 'Voice Clarity Boost', and 'Loudness Normalization (LUFS -14)'.
systemInstruction: You are a professional audio workstation UI engineer. Create crisp controls with tactile feedback.
